items.title: Migrate Google BigQuery to an open lakehouse on AWS with Apache Iceberg
items.summary: Learn how to migrate Google BigQuery workloads to an open lakehouse on AWS built on Apache Iceberg and Amazon S3. This post explains why an open lakehouse future-proofs your data, presents the target architecture on AWS, and walks through a step-by-step migration: assess, design, convert, migrate, cut over, and optimize.
items.creator: Saman Irfan
